title.narrative: Power Transmission Strengthening and Integration of Renewable Energy Project

description.narrative: The project will help the Government of Bangladesh improve the reliability, climate resilience, and efficiency of the national grid, while integrating renewable energy generation in the variable renewable energy hub in the southern district of Chattogram. The loan will also help strengthen the institutional capacity of Power Grid Bangladesh PLC through technological and managerial capacity building, develop a corporate strategy promoting gender equality and women's empowerment, and establish a training platform for renewable energy integration.
